title: Budibase: Cross-privilege Stored XSS in the Budibase Builder via broken HTML-escaping in `jsonFormatter.format()`…
description: Budibase versions up to 3.38.1 contain a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows a low-privileged user to inject malicious HTML/JavaScript into application data. When a builder or admin later views this data in the Budibase Builder interface, the payload executes in their high-privilege session due to broken HTML escaping and unsafe rendering of user input. The Builder interface lacks a Content-Security-Policy header, enabling unrestricted script execution. This vulnerability enables full workspace takeover by escalating from a low-privileged user to builder/admin privileges.
